title: Import / Export
importHint: Upload your Google Takeout zip (the Keep folder) or a zip of markdown files. Re-importing skips notes that already exist.
markdownImportHint: Pick one or more .md files — the first # heading becomes the title, and a file of - [ ] items becomes a checklist. For a whole vault, zip it and use the field above.
exportHint: Download all notes, labels, settings and attachments as a zip, plus a markdown/ copy of every note. The link expires after 24 hours.
importShared_one: {{count}} note was shared in Keep — collaborators are not imported.
importShared_other: {{count}} notes were shared in Keep — collaborators are not imported.
